findings.claim: For a matched language pair, no zero-weight Boolean records => category1; any zero-weight record with low Boolean bit0 => category3; otherwise any such bit1 record => category2. Category3 wins mixed bits. Nonzero weights do not set these category bits.
No matching unordered language pair returns category0; x1 is not initialized to a weight on that path and caller ignores it. Zero-feature matched pair instead returns category1 with sum0.

A feature entry first-word sentinel -2 terminates accumulation and enters remaining-entry cleanup; existing category bits and sum are retained. Meaning/emission condition unknown without extractor body.

Category3 sets sticky overall veto sentinel 0x8000000000000002. Without it, any category2 candidate takes precedence over category1 weight winner; later category2 overwrites earlier category2. Category0 skipped.
Category1 comparison uses signed32 greater-than. Equal sums keep earlier category1 candidate. This is category-specific, not a universal confidence threshold.
